locator: I q.103 a.5 ad 2: Government implies a certain change effected by the governor in the things governed
interpretation: 'Government implies a certain change effected by the governor in the things governed. Now every movement is the act of a movable thing, caused by the moving principle.' Read as: a governor moves what it governs in some respect, in the prima via's sense of moving (motus as the act of the movable caused by the mover). Basis: the English Dominican translation (web snapshot); a candidate for upgrade once a pinned Latin witness of q.103 exists.
